podcast.title: Background
podcast.body: Jimmy Mitchell was a blind, mentally challenged singer from Dallas. "We don't know too much about him other than Jimmy was a blind, mentally challenged singer from Dallas."

podcast.title: Karaoke Contest Win
podcast.body: His musical career gained momentum in the 1990s when he won a karaoke contest. "In the 1990s, he won a karaoke contest, which resulted in the recording of an album in Denton, Texas."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Musical Style Comparison
podcast.body: Students of outsider music might notice similarities between his style and that of Wesley Willis, another performer in the genre. "If you're a student of outsider music, you might hear some of the similarities between his style and that of Wesley Willis, a performer covered on a previous episode on this subject."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
